integrity: The Gaussian-integer incidence, exact matrix polynomial, tree determinant and all local Smith profiles are independently reconstructible from the included standard-library program; program output is included.
scientific_limitations: Canonical finite graph invariant of the complex Klein point-plane configuration, not a Picard or Néron–Severi lattice of an ambient surface.
Historical-priority assessment is not an independent literature audit; an unindexed graph database or older synonym may contain the same Smith form.
No assertion about positive-characteristic specialization or a canonical semistable degeneration of the original arrangement.
title: The integral critical group of Klein's sixty-point/sixty-plane incidence graph
